notes: Map epic 2 terrain shaping (MMR-248 freezes the keys; MMR-278 implements the stage in terrain_compiler.cpp and tunes every value by its gates; findings section 15). The stage runs on the canonical periodic grid after travel placement, so pads use the final settlement positions; navigation keeps its own scaled, unshaped field. despike: a land sample steeper than maxSlopeDeg above all its neighbours is lowered, ridges and valleys (at least ridgeNeighbours opposite neighbours within the bound) kept, at most sweeps passes in a fixed order. coast: land and sea rise caps from the shoreline over bandSamples samples. pads: each settlement's pad (radius in map units: the vanilla footprint radius at the 0.5 look scale) flattened to at most maxSlopeDeg, blended over blendSamples, touching pads merged. lakes: beds flattened bedBelowLevel world units below the lake level and shores kept shoreAboveLevel above it, so no lake is newly hidden. coherence fixes the order. lowPass: a mild separable low-pass at 257 samples, masked to keep sea, lakes and coast. normals: surface.cpp builds the normal map from a copy of the field smoothed with kernel. resolution: the 513-sample cubic B-spline output (level 7) is used only when fine is true, which MMR-249's go decides. gates: the offline gates on worlds A and B (evidence/fwg/terrain-shaping.json).
